key_idea: Keep swapping until there are fewer than 3 of each fruit.
steps: 3 pears become 1 orange: 2 pears and 5 oranges.
3 oranges become 1 pear: 3 pears and 2 oranges.
3 pears become 1 orange: 0 pears and 3 oranges.
3 oranges become 1 pear: 1 pear and nothing else. Nothing more can change.
